sections.label: Book 18
sections.name: Agni's consecration as king; the Stream of Riches

verses.sa: वाजश्च मे प्रसवश्च मे प्रयतिश्च मे प्रसितिश्च मे धीतिश्च मे क्रतुश्च मे स्वरश्च मे श्लोकश्च मे श्रवश्च मे श्रुतिश्च मे ज्योतिश्च मे स्वश्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: vājaśca me prasavaśca me prayatiśca me prasitiśca me dhītiśca me kratuśca me svaraśca me ślokaśca me śravaśca me śrutiśca me jyotiśca me svaśca me yajñena kalpantām
verses.en: May my strength and my gain, and my inclination and my influence, and my thought and my mental power, and my praise and my fame, and my renown and my light, and my heaven prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sa: प्राणश्च मेऽपानश्च मे व्यानश्च मेऽसुश्च मे चित्तं च म आधीतं च मे वाक् च मे मनश्च मे चक्षुश्च मे श्रोत्रं च मे दक्षश्च मे बलं च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: prāṇaśca me'pānaśca me vyānaśca me'suśca me cittaṃ ca ma ādhītaṃ ca me vāk ca me manaśca me cakṣuśca me śrotraṃ ca me dakṣaśca me balaṃ ca me yajñena kalpantām
verses.en: May my breathing and my out -breathing, and my through breathing and my vital spirit, and my thought and my reflection, and my voice and my mind, and my eye and my ear, and my ability and my strength prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sa: ओजश्च मे सहश्च म आत्मा च मे तनूश्च मे शर्म च मे वर्म च मेऽङ्गानि च मेऽस्थीनि च मे परूंषि च मे शरीराणि च म आयुश्च मे जरा च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: ojaśca me sahaśca ma ātmā ca me tanūśca me śarma ca me varma ca me'ṅgāni ca me'sthīni ca me parūṃṣi ca me śarīrāṇi ca ma āyuśca me jarā ca me yajñena kalpantām
verses.en: May my energy and my force, and my self and my body, and my shelter and my shield, and my limbs and my bones, and my joints and my members, and my life and my old age prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sa: ज्यैष्ठ्यं च मे आधिपत्यं च मे मन्युश्च मे भामश्च मेऽमश्च मेऽम्भश्च मे जेमा च मे महिमा च मे वरिमा च मे प्रथिमा च मे वर्षिमा च मे द्राघिमा च मे वृद्धं च मे वृद्धिश्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: jyaiṣṭhyaṃ ca me ādhipatyaṃ ca me manyuśca me bhāmaśca me'maśca me'mbhaśca me jemā ca me mahimā ca me varimā ca me prathimā ca me varṣimā ca me drāghimā ca me vṛddhaṃ ca me vṛddhiśca me yajñena kalpantām
verses.en: May my preeminence and my overlordship, and my wrath and my angry passion, and my violence and my impetuosity, and my victorious power and my greatness, and my breadth and my width, and my height and my length, and my increase and my improvement prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sa: सत्यं च मे श्रद्धा च मे जगच्च मे धनं च मे विश्वं च मे महश्च मे क्रीडा च मे मोदश्च मे जातं च मे जनिष्यमाणं च मे सूक्तं च मे सुकृतं च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: satyaṃ ca me śraddhā ca me jagacca me dhanaṃ ca me viśvaṃ ca me mahaśca me krīḍā ca me modaśca me jātaṃ ca me janiṣyamāṇaṃ ca me sūktaṃ ca me sukṛtaṃ ca me yajñena kalpantām
verses.en: May my truth and my faith, and my cattle and my wealth, and my goods and my pleasure, and my play and my enjoyment, and my children and my future children, and my hymn and my pious act prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sa: ऋतं च मेऽमृतं च मे ऽयक्ष्मं च मे ऽनामयच्च मे जीवातुश्च मे दीर्घायुत्वं च मेऽनमित्रं च मे ऽभयं च मे सुखं च मे शयनं च मे सूषाश्च मे सुदिनं च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: ṛtaṃ ca me'mṛtaṃ ca me 'yakṣmaṃ ca me 'nāmayacca me jīvātuśca me dīrghāyutvaṃ ca me'namitraṃ ca me 'bhayaṃ ca me sukhaṃ ca me śayanaṃ ca me sūṣāśca me sudinaṃ ca me yajñena kalpantām
verses.en: May my religious rite and my immortality, and my freedom from consumption and my freedom from disease, and my life and my longevity, and my freedom from enemies and my freedom from danger, and my happiness and my lying down, and my fair dawn and my fair day prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sa: यन्ता च मे धर्ता च मे क्षेमश्च मे धृतिश्च मे विश्वं च मे महश्च मे संविच्च मे ज्ञात्रं च मे सूश्च मे प्रसूशच मे सीरं च मे लयश्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: yantā ca me dhartā ca me kṣemaśca me dhṛtiśca me viśvaṃ ca me mahaśca me saṃvicca me jñātraṃ ca me sūśca me prasūśaca me sīraṃ ca me layaśca me yajñena kalpantām
verses.en: May my controller and my supporter, and my security and my firmnesjj, and my goods and my pleasure, and my knowledge and my understanding, and my begetting and aud my propagation, aud and my plough and my harrow prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sa: शं च मे मयश्च मे प्रियं च मेऽनुकामश्च मे कामश्च मे सौमनसश्च मे भगश्च मे द्रविणं च मे भद्रं च मे श्रेयश्च मे वसीयश्च मे यशश्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: śaṃ ca me mayaśca me priyaṃ ca me'nukāmaśca me kāmaśca me saumanasaśca me bhagaśca me draviṇaṃ ca me bhadraṃ ca me śreyaśca me vasīyaśca me yaśaśca me yajñena kalpantām
verses.en: May my welfare and my comfort, and I hold dear and what I desire, and my love and my gratification, and my enjoyment and my substance, and my happiness and my felicity, and my higher bliss and my fame prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sa: ऊर्क् च मे सूनृता च मे पयश्च मे रसश्च मे घृतं च मे मधु च मे सग्धिश्च मे सपीतिश्च मे कृषिश्च मे वृष्टिश्च मे जैत्रं च म औद्भिद्यं च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: ūrk ca me sūnṛtā ca me payaśca me rasaśca me ghṛtaṃ ca me madhu ca me sagdhiśca me sapītiśca me kṛṣiśca me vṛṣṭiśca me jaitraṃ ca ma audbhidyaṃ ca me yajñena kalpantām
verses.en: May my vigour and my pleasantness, and my milk and my sap, and my butter and my honey, and my meal in company and my drinking in company, and my plough ing and my husbandry, and my superiority and my preeminence prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sa: रयिश्च मे रायश्च मे पुष्टं च मे पुष्टिश्च मे विभु च मे प्रभु च मे पूर्णं च मे पूर्णतरं च मे कुयवं च मेऽक्षितं च मेऽन्नं च मेऽक्षुच्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: rayiśca me rāyaśca me puṣṭaṃ ca me puṣṭiśca me vibhu ca me prabhu ca me pūrṇaṃ ca me pūrṇataraṃ ca me kuyavaṃ ca me'kṣitaṃ ca me'nnaṃ ca me'kṣucca me yajñena kalpantām
verses.en: May my wealth and my property, and my prosperity and my growth, and my pervading power and my lordship, and my abundance and my greater abundance, and my bad harvest and my unwasted crop, and my food and my satiety prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sa: वित्तं च मे वेद्यं च मे भूतं च मे भविष्यच्च मे सुगं च मे सुपथ्यं च म ऋद्धं च म ऋद्धिश्च मे क्लृप्तं च मे क्लृप्तिश्च मे मतिश्च मे सुमतिश्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: vittaṃ ca me vedyaṃ ca me bhūtaṃ ca me bhaviṣyacca me sugaṃ ca me supathyaṃ ca ma ṛddhaṃ ca ma ṛddhiśca me klṛptaṃ ca me klṛptiśca me matiśca me sumatiśca me yajñena kalpantām
verses.en: May my gain and my future gain, and what I have and what I shall have, and my good road and my good path, and my success and my succeeding, and my achievement and my contrivance, and my thought and my good counsel prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sa: व्रीहयश्च मे यवाश्च मे माषाश्च मे तिलाश्च मे मुद्राश्च मे खल्वाश्च मे प्रियङ्गवश्च मेऽणवश्च मे श्यामाकाश्च मे नीवाराश्च मे गोधूमाश्च मे मसूराश्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: vrīhayaśca me yavāśca me māṣāśca me tilāśca me mudrāśca me khalvāśca me priyaṅgavaśca me'ṇavaśca me śyāmākāśca me nīvārāśca me godhūmāśca me masūrāśca me yajñena kalpantām
verses.en: May my rice-plants and my barley, and my beans and my sesamum, and my kidney-beans and my vetches, and my millet and my Panicum Milliaceum, and my Panicum Frumentaceum and my wild rice, and my wheat and my lentils prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sa: अश्मा च मे मृत्तिका च मे गिरयश्च मे पर्वताश्च मे सिकताश्च मे वनस्पतयश्च मे हिरण्यं च मेऽयश्च मे श्यामं च मे लोहं च मे सीसं च मे त्रपु च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: aśmā ca me mṛttikā ca me girayaśca me parvatāśca me sikatāśca me vanaspatayaśca me hiraṇyaṃ ca me'yaśca me śyāmaṃ ca me lohaṃ ca me sīsaṃ ca me trapu ca me yajñena kalpantām
verses.en: May my stone and my clay, and my hills and my mountains, and my pebbles and my trees, and my gold and my bronze, and my copper and my iron, and my lead and my tin prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sa: अग्निश्च म आपश्च मे वीरुधश्च म ओषधयश्च मे कृष्टपच्याश्च मेऽकृष्टपच्याश्च मे ग्राम्याश्च मे पशव आरण्याश्च मे वित्तं च मे वित्तिश्च मे भूतं च मे भूतिश्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: agniśca ma āpaśca me vīrudhaśca ma oṣadhayaśca me kṛṣṭapacyāśca me'kṛṣṭapacyāśca me grāmyāśca me paśava āraṇyāśca me vittaṃ ca me vittiśca me bhūtaṃ ca me bhūtiśca me yajñena kalpantām
verses.en: May my fire and my water, and my creepers and my plants, and my plants with culture-ripened fruit and my plants, with fruit ripened without culture, and my domestic animals and my wild animals, and my substance and my future substance, and my belongings and my power be produced by sacrifice.

verses.sa: वसु च मे वसतिश्च मे कर्म च मे शक्तिश्च मे ऽर्थश्च म एमश्च म इत्या च मे गतिश्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: vasu ca me vasatiśca me karma ca me śaktiśca me 'rthaśca ma emaśca ma ityā ca me gatiśca me yajñena kalpantām
verses.en: May my treasure and my dwelling, and my religious service and 'my ability to perform it, and my object and my course, and my way and my going prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sa: अग्निश्च म इन्द्रश्च मे सोमश्च म इन्द्रश्च मे सविता च म इन्द्रश्च मे सरस्वती च म इन्द्रश्च मे पूषा च म इन्द्रश्च मे बृहस्पतिश्च म इन्द्रश्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: agniśca ma indraśca me somaśca ma indraśca me savitā ca ma indraśca me sarasvatī ca ma indraśca me pūṣā ca ma indraśca me bṛhaspatiśca ma indraśca me yajñena kalpantām
verses.en: May my Agni and my Indra, and my Soma and my Indra, and my Savitar and my Indra, and my Saras vati and my Indra, and my PAshan and my Indra prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sa: मित्रश्च म इन्द्रश्च मे वरुणश्च म इन्द्रश्च मे धाता च म इन्द्रश्च मे त्वष्टा च म इन्द्रश्च मे मरुतश्च म इन्द्रश्च मे विश्वे च मे देवा इन्द्रश्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: mitraśca ma indraśca me varuṇaśca ma indraśca me dhātā ca ma indraśca me tvaṣṭā ca ma indraśca me marutaśca ma indraśca me viśve ca me devā indraśca me yajñena kalpantām
verses.en: N May my Mitra and my Indra, and my Varuna and my Indra, and my Dhitar and my Indra, and my Maruts and my Indra, and my All^Gods and my Indra prosper by sacrifice,

verses.sa: पृथिवी च म इन्द्रश्च मेऽन्तरिक्षं च म इन्द्रश्च मे द्यौश्च म इन्द्रश्च मे समाश्च म इन्द्रश्च मे नक्षत्राणि च म इन्द्रश्च मे दिशश्च म इन्द्रश्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: pṛthivī ca ma indraśca me'ntarikṣaṃ ca ma indraśca me dyauśca ma indraśca me samāśca ma indraśca me nakṣatrāṇi ca ma indraśca me diśaśca ma indraśca me yajñena kalpantām
verses.en: May my earth and my Indra, and my Air and my Indra, and my Sky and my Indra, and my Half-months and my Indra, and my Lunar Mansions and my Indra, and my Sky-regions and my Indra prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sa: अंशुश्च मे रश्मिश्च मेऽदाभ्यश्च मेऽधिपतिश्च म उपांशुश्च मेऽन्तर्यामश्च म ऐन्द्रवायवश्च मे मैत्रावरुणश्च म आश्विनश्च मे प्रतिप्रस्थानश्च मे शुक्रश्च मे मन्थी च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: aṃśuśca me raśmiśca me'dābhyaśca me'dhipatiśca ma upāṃśuśca me'ntaryāmaśca ma aindravāyavaśca me maitrāvaruṇaśca ma āśvinaśca me pratiprasthānaśca me śukraśca me manthī ca me yajñena kalpantām
verses.en: May my Amsu and my Basmi, and my Adhipati and my Up^msu, Up>Aint>u, and my Antary ma and my Aindra-Vlyava, and my Maitri, Varuna and my A$vina and my Pratiprasthlna, and my $Sukra and my Manthin proper by sacrifice,

verses.sa: आग्रयाणश्च मे वैश्वदेवश्च मे ध्रुवश्च मे वैश्वानरश्च म ऐन्द्राग्नश्च मे महावैश्वदेश्च मे मरुत्वतीयाश्च मे निष्केवल्यश्च मे सावित्रश्च मे सारस्वतश्च मे पात्नीवतश्च मे हारियोजनश्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: āgrayāṇaśca me vaiśvadevaśca me dhruvaśca me vaiśvānaraśca ma aindrāgnaśca me mahāvaiśvadeśca me marutvatīyāśca me niṣkevalyaśca me sāvitraśca me sārasvataśca me pātnīvataśca me hāriyojanaśca me yajñena kalpantām
verses.en: May my Agrayana and my Vaisvadeva, and my Dhruva and my Vai^vAnara, and my Aindragna and my myMahivaifvadeya, and my Marutvatiya and my Nishkevalya, and my yitra and my Sarasvata, and my PS.tnivata and ray Hdriyojana prosper by saorifioe.

verses.sa: स्रुचश्च मे चमसाश्च मे वायव्यानि च मे द्रोणकलशश्च मे ग्रावाणश्च मेऽधिषवणे च मे पूतभृच्च म आधवनीयश्च मे वेदिश्च मे बर्हिश्च मेऽवभृतश्च मे स्वगाकारश्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: srucaśca me camasāśca me vāyavyāni ca me droṇakalaśaśca me grāvāṇaśca me'dhiṣavaṇe ca me pūtabhṛcca ma ādhavanīyaśca me vediśca me barhiśca me'vabhṛtaśca me svagākāraśca me yajñena kalpantām
verses.en: May my ladles and my cups, and my V&yu vessels and my Soma reservoirs, and my pressing-stones and my! two press? boards, and my Piitabhrit and my Ahavaniya, and my altar and altar-grass, and my mV Avabhritha and my cries of oi Good-speed prosper by sacrifice,

verses.sa: अग्निश्च मे घर्मश्च मेऽर्कश्च मे सूर्यश्च मे प्राणश्च मेऽश्वमेधश्च मे पृथिवी च मेऽदितिश्च मे दितिश्च मे द्यौश्च मेऽङ्गुलयः शक्वरयो दिशश्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: agniśca me gharmaśca me'rkaśca me sūryaśca me prāṇaśca me'śvamedhaśca me pṛthivī ca me'ditiśca me ditiśca me dyauśca me'ṅgulayaḥ śakvarayo diśaśca me yajñena kalpantām
verses.en: May. my Agni and my Gharma, and my Arka and my SArya, and my Prana and my Asvamedha, and my Prithivi and my Aditi, and my Diti and my Sky, and my fingers, powers, and sky^regions prosper by sacrifice,

verses.sa: व्रतं च म ऋतवश्च मे तपश्च मे संवत्सरश्च मेऽहोरात्रे ऊर्वष्ठीवे बृहद्रथन्तरे च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: vrataṃ ca ma ṛtavaśca me tapaśca me saṃvatsaraśca me'horātre ūrvaṣṭhīve bṛhadrathantare ca me yajñena kalpantām
verses.en: May my vow and my mj seasons, and aad my austere devotion, and my day and night, thighs and knees, and two Great Rathantaras prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sa: एका च मे तिस्रश्च मे तिस्रश्च मे पञ्च च मे पञ्च च मे सप्त च मे सप्त च मे नव च मे नव च म एकादश च म एकादश च मे त्रयोदश च मे त्रयोदश च मे पञ्चदश च मे पञ्चदश च मे सप्तदश च मे सप्तदश च मे नवदश च मे नवदश च म एकविंशतिश्च म एकविंशतिश्च मे त्रयोविंशतिश्च मे त्रयोविंशतिश्च मे पञ्चविंशतिश्च मे पञ्चविंशतिश्च मे सप्तविंशतिश्च मे सप्तविंशतिश्च मे नवविंशतिश्च मे नवविंशतिश्च म एकत्रिंशच्च म एकत्रिंशच्च मे त्रयस्त्रिंशच्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: ekā ca me tisraśca me tisraśca me pañca ca me pañca ca me sapta ca me sapta ca me nava ca me nava ca ma ekādaśa ca ma ekādaśa ca me trayodaśa ca me trayodaśa ca me pañcadaśa ca me pañcadaśa ca me saptadaśa ca me saptadaśa ca me navadaśa ca me navadaśa ca ma ekaviṃśatiśca ma ekaviṃśatiśca me trayoviṃśatiśca me trayoviṃśatiśca me pañcaviṃśatiśca me pañcaviṃśatiśca me saptaviṃśatiśca me saptaviṃśatiśca me navaviṃśatiśca me navaviṃśatiśca ma ekatriṃśacca ma ekatriṃśacca me trayastriṃśacca me yajñena kalpantām
verses.en: May my One and my Three, and my Three and ray Five, and my Five, and my and my SeVen (and similarly up to thirty-three) prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sa: चतस्रश्च मेऽष्टौ च मेऽष्टौ च मे द्वादश च मे द्वादश च मे षोडश च मे षोडश च मे विंशतिश्च मे विंशतिश्च मे चतुर्विंशतिश्च मे चतुर्विंशतिश्च मेऽष्टाविंशतिश्च मेऽष्टाविंशतिश्च मे द्वात्रिंशच्च मे द्वात्रिंशच्च मे षट्त्रिंशच्च मे षट्त्रिंशच्च मे चत्वारिंशच्च मे चत्वारिंशच्च मे चतुश्चत्वारिंशच्च मे चतुश्चत्वारिंशच्च मेऽष्टाचत्वारिंशच्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: catasraśca me'ṣṭau ca me'ṣṭau ca me dvādaśa ca me dvādaśa ca me ṣoḍaśa ca me ṣoḍaśa ca me viṃśatiśca me viṃśatiśca me caturviṃśatiśca me caturviṃśatiśca me'ṣṭāviṃśatiśca me'ṣṭāviṃśatiśca me dvātriṃśacca me dvātriṃśacca me ṣaṭtriṃśacca me ṣaṭtriṃśacca me catvāriṃśacca me catvāriṃśacca me catuścatvāriṃśacca me catuścatvāriṃśacca me'ṣṭācatvāriṃśacca me yajñena kalpantām
verses.en: May my Four and my Eight and my Twelve (and similarly up to forty-eight) prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sa: त्र्यविश्च मे त्र्यवी च मे दित्यवाट् च मे दित्यौही च मे पञ्चाविश्च मे पञ्चावी च मे त्रिवत्सश्च मे त्रिवत्सा च मे तुर्यवाट् च मे तुर्यौही च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: tryaviśca me tryavī ca me dityavāṭ ca me dityauhī ca me pañcāviśca me pañcāvī ca me trivatsaśca me trivatsā ca me turyavāṭ ca me turyauhī ca me yajñena kalpantām
verses.en: May my eighteen-months steer and my eighteen-months heifer) and my two-year bull and cow (and similarly up to four-year) prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sa: पष्ठवाट् च मे पष्ठौही च म उक्षा च मे वशा च म ऋषभश्च मे वेहच्च मेऽनड्वाँश्च मे धेनुश्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: paṣṭhavāṭ ca me paṣṭhauhī ca ma ukṣā ca me vaśā ca ma ṛṣabhaśca me vehacca me'naḍvāṃśca me dhenuśca me yajñena kalpantām
verses.en: May my six-year bull and my six-year cow, and my bull and my barren cow, and my young bull and my calf-slipping cow, and my ox and my milch-cow prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sa: वाजाय स्वाहा प्रसवाय स्वाहाऽपिजाय स्वाहा क्रतवे स्वाहा वसवे स्वाहाऽहर्पतये स्वाहाऽह्ने मुग्धाय स्वाहा मुग्धाय वैनंशिनाय स्वाहा विनंशिन आन्त्यायनाय स्वाहाऽऽन्त्याय भौवनाय स्वाहा भुवनस्य पतये स्वाहाऽधिपतये स्वाहा प्रजापतये स्वाहा। इयं ते राण्मित्राय यन्ताऽसि यमन ऊर्जे त्वा वृष्ट्यै त्वा प्रजानां त्वाऽऽधिपत्याय॥
verses.tr: vājāya svāhā prasavāya svāhā'pijāya svāhā kratave svāhā vasave svāhā'harpataye svāhā'hne mugdhāya svāhā mugdhāya vainaṃśināya svāhā vinaṃśina āntyāyanāya svāhā''ntyāya bhauvanāya svāhā bhuvanasya pataye svāhā'dhipataye svāhā prajāpataye svāhā iyaṃ te rāṇmitrāya yantā'si yamana ūrje tvā vṛṣṭyai tvā prajānāṃ tvā''dhipatyāya
verses.en: To strength, Hail! To Gain, Hail! To After-bom, Hail! I To Power, Hail! I To Vasu, Hail! I To the Lord of Days, Hail! To the' Failing Day, Hail! I To the Failing Sprung from the Transitory, Hail! To the Transitory sprung from the Final, Hail! To the Final Mundane, Hail! I To the Lord of the World, Hail! To the Sovran Lord, Hail! To Prajdpati, Hail! This is thy kingdom. Thou art a guiding controller for the friend. Thee for vigour, thee for rain, thee for the sovran lordship of creatures.

verses.sa: आयुर्यज्ञेन कल्पतां प्राणो यज्ञेन कल्पतां चक्षुर्यज्ञेन कल्पतां श्रोत्रं यज्ञेन कल्पतां वाग्यज्ञेन कल्पतां मनो यज्ञेन कल्पतामात्मा यज्ञेन कल्पतां ब्रह्मा यज्ञेन कल्पतां ज्योतिर्यज्ञेन कल्पतां स्वर्यज्ञेन कल्पतां पृष्ठं यज्ञेन कल्पतां यज्ञो यज्ञेन कल्पताम्। स्तोमश्च यजुश्च ऋक् च साम च बृहच्च रथन्तरं च। स्वर्देवा अगन्मामृता अभूम प्रजापतेः प्रजा अभूम वेट् स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: āyuryajñena kalpatāṃ prāṇo yajñena kalpatāṃ cakṣuryajñena kalpatāṃ śrotraṃ yajñena kalpatāṃ vāgyajñena kalpatāṃ mano yajñena kalpatāmātmā yajñena kalpatāṃ brahmā yajñena kalpatāṃ jyotiryajñena kalpatāṃ svaryajñena kalpatāṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ yajñena kalpatāṃ yajño yajñena kalpatām stomaśca yajuśca ṛk ca sāma ca bṛhacca rathantaraṃ ca svardevā aganmāmṛtā abhūma prajāpateḥ prajā abhūma veṭ svāhā
verses.en: May life succeed through sacrifice. May life^breath thrive by sacrifice. May the eye thrive by sacrifice. May the ear thrive by sacrifice. May the voice thrive by sacrifice. May the mind thrive by sacrifice. May the self thrive by sacrifice. May Brahma thrive by sacrifice. May light succeed by sacrifice. May heaven succeed by sacrifice. May the hymn thrive by sacrifice. May sacrifice thrive by sacrifice; And laud and sacrificial text, and Verse of praise and Sd, ma chant, The Brihat and R Rathantara. Gods, we have gone to light. We have become the children of Preijipati. We have become immortal.

verses.sa: वाजस्य नु प्रसवे मातरं महीमदितिं नाम वचसा करामहे। यस्यामिदं विश्वं भुवनमाविवेश तस्यां नो देवः सविता धर्म साविषत्॥
verses.tr: vājasya nu prasave mātaraṃ mahīmaditiṃ nāma vacasā karāmahe yasyāmidaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanamāviveśa tasyāṃ no devaḥ savitā dharma sāviṣat
verses.en: In gain of wealth we celebrate, etc. IX.

verses.sa: विश्वे अद्य मरुतो विश्व ऊती विश्वे भवन्त्वग्नयः समिद्धाः। विश्वे नो देवा अवसाऽऽगमन्तु विश्वमस्तु द्रविणं वाजो अस्मे॥
verses.tr: viśve adya maruto viśva ūtī viśve bhavantvagnayaḥ samiddhāḥ viśve no devā avasā''gamantu viśvamastu draviṇaṃ vājo asme
verses.en: This day come all the Maruts, all to aid us! Let all the fires be thoroughly enkindled. May the All-Gods come hither with protection. May we possess all property and riches.

verses.sa: वाजो नः सप्त प्रदिशश्चतस्रो वा परावतः। वाजो नो विश्वैर्देवैर्धनसाताविहावतु॥
verses.tr: vājo naḥ sapta pradiśaścatasro vā parāvataḥ vājo no viśvairdevairdhanasātāvihāvatu
verses.en: May our strength fill the regions seven, fill the four distant places full. Here may our riches guard us with the 'All-Gods in the gain of wealth.

verses.sa: वाजो नो अद्य प्र सुवाति दानं वाजो देवाँ२ ऋतुभिः कल्पयाति। वाजो हि मा सर्ववीरं जजान विश्वा आशा वाजपतिर्जयेयम्॥
verses.tr: vājo no adya pra suvāti dānaṃ vājo devāṃ2 ṛtubhiḥ kalpayāti vājo hi mā sarvavīraṃ jajāna viśvā āśā vājapatirjayeyam
verses.en: May strength to-day procure for us donation: strength range the Gods together with the Seasons. Yea, strength hath made me rich in store of 'heroes. As lord of strength may I gain all the regions.

verses.sa: वाजः पुरस्तादुत मध्यतो नो वाजो देवान् हविषा वर्धयाति। वाजो हि मा सर्ववीरं चकार सर्वा आशा वाजपतिर्भवेयम्॥
verses.tr: vājaḥ purastāduta madhyato no vājo devān haviṣā vardhayāti vājo hi mā sarvavīraṃ cakāra sarvā āśā vājapatirbhaveyam
verses.en: Strength be before us, in the midst among us. May strength exalt the Gods with our oblation. Yea, strength hath made me rich in store of heroes. As lord of strength may I gain all the regions.

verses.sa: सं मा सृजामि पयसा पृथिव्याः सं मा सृजाम्यद्भिरोषधीभिः। सोऽहं वाजं सनेयमग्ने॥
verses.tr: saṃ mā sṛjāmi payasā pṛthivyāḥ saṃ mā sṛjāmyadbhiroṣadhībhiḥ so'haṃ vājaṃ saneyamagne
verses.en: With milk of Prithivi do I unite me, unite myself with waters and with plants. As such may I gain strength, O Agni.

verses.sa: पयः पृथिव्यां पय ओषधीषु पयो दिव्यन्तरिक्षे पयो धाः। पयस्वतीः प्रदिशः सन्तु मह्यम्॥
verses.tr: payaḥ pṛthivyāṃ paya oṣadhīṣu payo divyantarikṣe payo dhāḥ payasvatīḥ pradiśaḥ santu mahyam
verses.en: Store milk in earth and milk in plants, milk in the sky and milk in air. Teeming with milk for me be all the regions.

verses.sa: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवेऽश्विनोर्बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्याम्। सरस्वत्यै वाचो यन्तुर्यन्त्रेणाग्नेः साम्राज्येनाभिषिञ्चामि॥
verses.tr: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām sarasvatyai vāco yanturyantreṇāgneḥ sāmrājyenābhiṣiñcāmi
verses.en: Thee by the radiant tar's impulsion, with arms of Afvins, with the hands of Pushan, Controlled by VAk Sarasvati's Controller, with Agni's sole dominion I besprinkle.

verses.sa: ऋताषाडृतधामाऽग्निर्गन्धर्वस्तस्यौषधयोऽप्सरसो मुदो नाम। स न इदं ब्रह्म क्षत्रं पातु तस्मै स्वाहा वाट् ताभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: ṛtāṣāḍṛtadhāmā'gnirgandharvastasyauṣadhayo'psaraso mudo nāma sa na idaṃ brahma kṣatraṃ pātu tasmai svāhā vāṭ tābhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Maintainor of Law, true by nature, Agni is the Gandharva. The plants are his Apsarases, namely Delights, ay he protect this our Priesthood and Nobility. To him AU-hail! Ave! To those All-hail!

verses.sa: संहितो विश्वसामा सूर्यो गन्धर्वस्तस्य मरीचयोऽप्सरस आयुवो नाम। स न इदं ब्रह्म क्षत्रं पातु तस्मै स्वाहा वाट् ताभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: saṃhito viśvasāmā sūryo gandharvastasya marīcayo'psarasa āyuvo nāma sa na idaṃ brahma kṣatraṃ pātu tasmai svāhā vāṭ tābhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: The Conjoined, Visvakarman, Silrya is the Gandharva. His motes are his Apsarases, Swift-moving. May |d^y he protect, etc., as in

verses.sa: सुषुम्णः सूर्यरश्मिश्चन्द्रमा गन्धर्वस्तस्य नक्षत्राण्यप्सरसो भेकुरयो नाम। स न इदं ब्रह्म क्षत्रं पातु तस्मै स्वाहा वाट् ताभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: suṣumṇaḥ sūryaraśmiścandramā gandharvastasya nakṣatrāṇyapsaraso bhekurayo nāma sa na idaṃ brahma kṣatraṃ pātu tasmai svāhā vāṭ tābhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: The Highly' Blessed, the Moon whose rays are like the Sun's, Sim's, is the Gandharva. The Asterisms are his Apsarases, Luminous. May he protect, etc.

verses.sa: इषिरो विश्वव्यचा वातो गन्धर्वस्तस्यापो अप्सरस ऊर्जो नाम। स न इदं ब्रह्म क्षत्रं पातु तस्मै स्वाहा वाट् ताभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: iṣiro viśvavyacā vāto gandharvastasyāpo apsarasa ūrjo nāma sa na idaṃ brahma kṣatraṃ pātu tasmai svāhā vāṭ tābhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: The Quick, All -reaching, Wind is the Gandharva. The Waters are his Apsarases, named Energies. May he protect, etc.

verses.sa: भुज्युः सुपर्णो यज्ञो गन्धर्वतस्य दक्षिणा अप्सरस स्तावा नाम। स न इदं ब्रह्म क्षत्रं पातु तस्मै स्वाहा वाट् ताभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: bhujyuḥ suparṇo yajño gandharvatasya dakṣiṇā apsarasa stāvā nāma sa na idaṃ brahma kṣatraṃ pātu tasmai svāhā vāṭ tābhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: The Protecting, Strong-winged, Sacrifice is the Gandharva. Guerdons are his Apsarases, called Praisers. May he protect, etc.

verses.sa: प्रजापतिर्विश्वकर्मा मनो गन्धर्वस्तस्य ऋक्सामान्यप्सरस एष्टयो नाम। स न इदं ब्रह्म क्षत्रं पातु तस्मै स्वाहा वाट् ताभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: prajāpatirviśvakarmā mano gandharvastasya ṛksāmānyapsarasa eṣṭayo nāma sa na idaṃ brahma kṣatraṃ pātu tasmai svāhā vāṭ tābhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: The Lord of Creatures, Omnific, Mind i the Gandharva. Eichas and Sumanas are his Apsarases, called Wishings, May he protect, etc.

verses.sa: स नो भुवनस्य पते प्रजापते यस्य त उपरि गृहा यस्य वेह। अस्मै ब्रह्मणेऽस्मै क्षत्राय महि शर्म यच्छ स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: sa no bhuvanasya pate prajāpate yasya ta upari gṛhā yasya veha asmai brahmaṇe'smai kṣatrāya mahi śarma yaccha svāhā
verses.en: Lord of the World, Prajapati, whose are the homes above and here, Give great protection unto these, the Priesthood and Nobility.

verses.sa: समुद्रोऽसि नभस्वानार्द्रदानुः शम्भूर्मयोभूरभि मा वाहि स्वाहा। मारुतोऽसि मरुतां गणः शम्भूर्मयोभूरभि मा वाहि स्वाहाऽवस्यूरसि दुवस्वाञ्छम्भूर्मयोभूरभि मा वाहि स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: samudro'si nabhasvānārdradānuḥ śambhūrmayobhūrabhi mā vāhi svāhā māruto'si marutāṃ gaṇaḥ śambhūrmayobhūrabhi mā vāhi svāhā'vasyūrasi duvasvāñchambhūrmayobhūrabhi mā vāhi svāhā
verses.en: Thou art the vapoury sea that giveth moisture. Blow on me, thou, healthful and blessing-laden. Thou art the Maruts' own, the and of Maruts. Blow on me, etc. Seeker of aid art thou, receiving worship. Blow on me, etc.

verses.sa: यास्ते अग्ने सूर्ये रुचो दिवमातन्वन्ति रश्मिभिः। ताभिर्नो अद्य सर्वाभी रुचे जनाय नस्कृधि॥
verses.tr: yāste agne sūrye ruco divamātanvanti raśmibhiḥ tābhirno adya sarvābhī ruce janāya naskṛdhi
verses.en: Thy lights, O Agni, in the Sun, etc., as in.

verses.sa: या वो देवाः सूर्ये रुचो गोष्वश्वेषु या रुचः। इन्द्राग्नी ताभिः सर्वाभी रुचं नो धत्त बृहस्पते॥
verses.tr: yā vo devāḥ sūrye ruco goṣvaśveṣu yā rucaḥ indrāgnī tābhiḥ sarvābhī rucaṃ no dhatta bṛhaspate
verses.en: Lights of yours in the Sun, O Gods, etc., as in XIII..

verses.sa: रुचं नो धेहि ब्राह्मणेषु रुचं राजसु नस्कृधि। रुचं विश्येषु शूद्रेषु मयि धेहि रुचा रुचम्॥
verses.tr: rucaṃ no dhehi brāhmaṇeṣu rucaṃ rājasu naskṛdhi rucaṃ viśyeṣu śūdreṣu mayi dhehi rucā rucam
verses.en: Give lustre to our holy priests, set lustre in our ruling chiefs: Lustre to Vaisyas, Sfidras: give, through lustre; lustre unto me.

verses.sa: तत्त्वा यामि ब्रह्मणा वन्दमानस्तदा शास्ते यजमानो हविर्भिः। अहेडमानो वरुणेह बोध्युरुशंस मा न आयुः प्र मोषीः॥
verses.tr: tattvā yāmi brahmaṇā vandamānastadā śāste yajamāno havirbhiḥ aheḍamāno varuṇeha bodhyuruśaṃsa mā na āyuḥ pra moṣīḥ
verses.en: I ask this of thee with my prayer, adoring: J thy worship per asks this with his oblations. Varuna, stay thou here and be not angry: steal not our life from us, O thou Wide-Ruler.

verses.sa: स्वर्ण घर्मः स्वाहा स्वर्णार्कः स्वाहा स्वर्ण शुक्रः स्वाहा स्वर्ण ज्योतिः स्वाहा स्वर्ण सूर्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: svarṇa gharmaḥ svāhā svarṇārkaḥ svāhā svarṇa śukraḥ svāhā svarṇa jyotiḥ svāhā svarṇa sūryaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Heaven-like is Warmth, Hail! Heaven-like is Arka, Hail! HeaVen-like is the Bright One, Had! Heaven-like is Light, Hail! Heaven-like is Surya, Hail!

verses.sa: अग्निं युनज्मि शवसा घृतेन दिव्यं सुपर्णं वयसा बृहन्तम्। तेन वयं गमेम ब्रध्नस्य विष्टपं स्वो रुहाणा अधि नाकमुत्तमम्॥
verses.tr: agniṃ yunajmi śavasā ghṛtena divyaṃ suparṇaṃ vayasā bṛhantam tena vayaṃ gamema bradhnasya viṣṭapaṃ svo ruhāṇā adhi nākamuttamam
verses.en: I yoke with power and flowing butter Agni, divine, strong-pinioned, great with vital vigour. Through him may we approach the Bright One^s station, ascending to the loftiest sky, to heaven.

verses.sa: इमौ ते पक्षावजरौ पतत्रिणौ याभ्यां रक्षांस्यपहंस्यग्ने। ताभ्यां पतेम सुकृतामु लोकं यत्र ऋषयो जग्मुः प्रथमजाः पुराणाः॥
verses.tr: imau te pakṣāvajarau patatriṇau yābhyāṃ rakṣāṃsyapahaṃsyagne tābhyāṃ patema sukṛtāmu lokaṃ yatra ṛṣayo jagmuḥ prathamajāḥ purāṇāḥ
verses.en: With these thy two, ne'er-wasting feathered pinions wherewith thou drivest fiends aWay, O Agni, Let us fly to the regions of the pious whither' have gone the first-born ancient Eishis.

verses.sa: इन्दुर्दक्षः श्येन ऋतावा हिरण्यपक्षः शकुनो भुरण्युः। महान्त्सधस्थे ध्रुव आ निषत्तो नमस्ते अस्तु मा मा हिंसीः॥
verses.tr: indurdakṣaḥ śyena ṛtāvā hiraṇyapakṣaḥ śakuno bhuraṇyuḥ mahāntsadhasthe dhruva ā niṣatto namaste astu mā mā hiṃsīḥ
verses.en: The Drop, the powerful, the falcon, righteous, impetuous bird borne on his golden pinions. Great, stedfast, settled in the habitation—to thee be reverence! Forbear to harm me!

verses.sa: दिवो मूर्धाऽसि पृथिव्या नाभिरूर्गपामोषधीनाम्। विश्वायुः शर्म सप्रथा नमस्पथे॥
verses.tr: divo mūrdhā'si pṛthivyā nābhirūrgapāmoṣadhīnām viśvāyuḥ śarma saprathā namaspathe
verses.en: Centre of earth, heaven's head art thou, essence of waters and of plants. Eternal, far-spread refuge. Homage to the Path!

verses.sa: विश्वस्य मूर्धन्नधि तिष्ठसि श्रितः समुद्रे ते हृदयमप्स्वायुरपो दत्तोदधिं भिन्त। दिवस्पर्जन्यादन्तरिक्षात्पृथिव्यास्ततो नो वृष्ट्याव॥
verses.tr: viśvasya mūrdhannadhi tiṣṭhasi śritaḥ samudre te hṛdayamapsvāyurapo dattodadhiṃ bhinta divasparjanyādantarikṣātpṛthivyāstato no vṛṣṭyāva
verses.en: -\Attached thou standest at \he head of all the world. Thy heart is' in the sea, thy life is in the floods. Give water: cleave the reset reservoir. Help us with rain sent from the sky, Parjanya, firmament, or earth.

verses.sa: इष्टो यज्ञो भृगुभिराशीर्दा वसुभिः। तस्य न इष्टस्य प्रीतस्य द्रविणेहा गमेः॥
verses.tr: iṣṭo yajño bhṛgubhirāśīrdā vasubhiḥ tasya na iṣṭasya prītasya draviṇehā gameḥ
verses.en: By Bhrigus and by Vasus hath prayer-granting sacrifice been paid. Come, Wealth, into the house of him our dear, our well beloved one.

verses.sa: इष्टो अग्निराहुतः पिपर्तु न इष्टं हविः। स्वगेदं देवेभ्यो नमः॥
verses.tr: iṣṭo agnirāhutaḥ pipartu na iṣṭaṃ haviḥ svagedaṃ devebhyo namaḥ
verses.en: May Agni, served with saciifice and giftSj protect our offered food:.This homage be Good-speed to Gods! I

verses.sa: यदाकूतात्समसुस्रोद्धृदो वा मनसो वा सम्भृतं चक्षुषो वा। तदनु प्रेत सुकृतामु लोकं यत्र ऋषयो जग्मुः प्रथमजाः पुराणाः॥
verses.tr: yadākūtātsamasusroddhṛdo vā manaso vā sambhṛtaṃ cakṣuṣo vā tadanu preta sukṛtāmu lokaṃ yatra ṛṣayo jagmuḥ prathamajāḥ purāṇāḥ
verses.en: That which hath flowed from purpose or from judgment, or gathered from the wind or from the vision, Follow ye to the region of the pious whither have gone the first-born ancient Eishis.

verses.sa: एतं सधस्थ परि ते ददामि यमावहाच्छेवधिं जातवेदाः। अन्वागन्ता यज्ञपतिर्वो अत्र तं स्म जानीत परमे व्योमन्॥
verses.tr: etaṃ sadhastha pari te dadāmi yamāvahācchevadhiṃ jātavedāḥ anvāgantā yajñapatirvo atra taṃ sma jānīta parame vyoman
verses.en: To thee I trust this man, Celestial Dwelling! treasure which jitavedas shall bring hither. After you will the Sacrificer follow. Here recognize him in the highest heaven.

verses.sa: एतं जानाथ परमे व्योमन् देवाः सधस्था विद रूपमस्य। यदागच्छात्पथिभिर्देवयानैरिष्टापूर्ते कृणवाथाविरस्मै॥
verses.tr: etaṃ jānātha parame vyoman devāḥ sadhasthā vida rūpamasya yadāgacchātpathibhirdevayānairiṣṭāpūrte kṛṇavāthāvirasmai
verses.en: Acknowledge him, ye Gods, in highest heaven. Ye who are present, know the shape he weareth. When he approacheth by the God-ward pathways, reveal to him the meed of pious actions.

verses.sa: उद्बुध्यस्वाग्ने प्रति जागृहि त्वमिष्टापूर्ते सं सृजेथामयं च। अस्मिन्त्सधस्थे अध्युत्तरस्मिन्विश्वे देवा यजमानाश्च सीदत॥
verses.tr: udbudhyasvāgne prati jāgṛhi tvamiṣṭāpūrte saṃ sṛjethāmayaṃ ca asmintsadhasthe adhyuttarasminviśve devā yajamānāśca sīdata
verses.en: Wake up, O Agni, etc., as in XV.

verses.sa: येन वहसि सहस्रं येनाग्ने सर्ववेदसम्। तेनेमं यज्ञं नो नय स्वर्देवेषु गन्तवे॥
verses.tr: yena vahasi sahasraṃ yenāgne sarvavedasam tenemaṃ yajñaṃ no naya svardeveṣu gantave
verses.en: Convey our sacrifice to heaven, etc., as in XV.

verses.sa: प्रस्तरेण परिधिना स्रुचा वेद्या च बर्हिषा। ऋचेमं यज्ञं नो नय स्वर्देवेषु गन्तवे॥
verses.tr: prastareṇa paridhinā srucā vedyā ca barhiṣā ṛcemaṃ yajñaṃ no naya svardeveṣu gantave
verses.en: With Darbha-bunch. with fencing-wood, with spoon, with altar, holy grass, With laud, lead this our sacrifice to go to heaven among the Gods.

verses.sa: यद्दत्तं यत्परादानं यत्पूर्तं याश्च दक्षिणाः। तदग्निर्वैश्वकर्मणः स्वर्देवेषु नो दधत्॥
verses.tr: yaddattaṃ yatparādānaṃ yatpūrtaṃ yāśca dakṣiṇāḥ tadagnirvaiśvakarmaṇaḥ svardeveṣu no dadhat
verses.en: Our gifts, our charitable grants, our pious works, our fees to priests, May the Omnific's Agni set all this among the Gods in heaven.-.—- 11^—————

verses.sa: यत्र धारा अनपेता मधोर्घृतस्य च याः। तदग्निर्वैश्वकर्मणः स्वदेर्वेषु नो दधत्॥
verses.tr: yatra dhārā anapetā madhorghṛtasya ca yāḥ tadagnirvaiśvakarmaṇaḥ svaderveṣu no dadhat
verses.en: There where all never-failing streams of honey and of butter flow, May Agni, Visyakarman's own, place us in heaven among the Gods.

verses.sa: अग्निरस्मि जन्मना जातवेदा घृतं मे चक्षुरमृतं म आसन्। अर्कस्त्रिधातू रजसो विमानोऽजस्रो घर्मो हविरस्मि नाम॥
verses.tr: agnirasmi janmanā jātavedā ghṛtaṃ me cakṣuramṛtaṃ ma āsan arkastridhātū rajaso vimāno'jasro gharmo havirasmi nāma
verses.en: Agni am I who know by birth all creatures. Mine eye is butter, in my mouth is nectar. I am the triple light, the region's meter: exhaustless heat am!, I, named burnt oblation.

verses.sa: ऋचो नामास्मि यजू ंषि नामास्मि सामानि नामास्मि। ये अग्नयः पाञ्चजन्या अस्यां पृथिव्यामधि। तेषामसि त्वमुत्तमः प्र नो जीवातवे सुव॥
verses.tr: ṛco nāmāsmi yajū ṃṣi nāmāsmi sāmāni nāmāsmi ye agnayaḥ pāñcajanyā asyāṃ pṛthivyāmadhi teṣāmasi tvamuttamaḥ pra no jīvātave suva
verses.en: Praise-verses, sacrificial texts, and chanted hymns am I in name. Thou art the best of all the Fires among the fivefold race of man That burn upon this earth of ours. Speed thou us on to lengthened life.

verses.sa: वार्त्रहत्याय शवसे पृतनाषाह्याय च। इन्द्र त्वाऽऽवर्तयामसि॥
verses.tr: vārtrahatyāya śavase pṛtanāṣāhyāya ca indra tvā''vartayāmasi
verses.en: O Indra, for the strength that slays Vritra and conquers in the fight We turn thee hitherward to us.

verses.sa: सहदानुं पुरुहूत क्षियन्तमहस्तमिन्द्र सं पिणक् कुणारुम्। अभि वृत्रं वर्धमानं पियारुमपादमिन्द्र तवसा जघन्थ॥
verses.tr: sahadānuṃ puruhūta kṣiyantamahastamindra saṃ piṇak kuṇārum abhi vṛtraṃ vardhamānaṃ piyārumapādamindra tavasā jaghantha
verses.en: Thou, Indra, much-invoked, didst crush to pieces, Kun^ru, handless fiend who dwelt with D&nus. Thou with might, Indra, smotest dead the scorner, the footless Vritra as he waxed in vigour.

verses.sa: वि न इन्द्र मृधो जहि नीचा यच्छ पृतन्यतः। यो अस्माँ२ अभिदासत्यधरं गमया तमः॥
verses.tr: vi na indra mṛdho jahi nīcā yaccha pṛtanyataḥ yo asmāṃ2 abhidāsatyadharaṃ gamayā tamaḥ
verses.en: O Indra, beat our foes away, etc, as in VIII.

verses.sa: मृगो न भीमः कुचरो गिरिष्ठाः परावत आ जगन्था परस्याः। सृकं संशाय पविमिन्द्र तिग्मं वि शत्रून् ताढि वि मृधो नुदस्व॥
verses.tr: mṛgo na bhīmaḥ kucaro giriṣṭhāḥ parāvata ā jaganthā parasyāḥ sṛkaṃ saṃśāya pavimindra tigmaṃ vi śatrūn tāḍhi vi mṛdho nudasva
verses.en: Like some dread wild beast roaming on the mountain thou hast approached us from the farthest distance. Whetting thy bolt and thy sharp blade, O Indra, crush thou the foes and scatter those who hate us.

verses.sa: वैश्वानरो न ऊतय आ प्र यातु परावतः। अग्निर्नः सुष्टुतीरुप॥
verses.tr: vaiśvānaro na ūtaya ā pra yātu parāvataḥ agnirnaḥ suṣṭutīrupa
verses.en: To aid us let Vaisvanara come from the distance far away: Come Agni, to our eulogies!

verses.sa: पृष्टो दिवि पृष्टो अग्निः पृथिव्यां पृष्टो विश्वा ओषधीरा विवेश। वैश्वानरः सहसा पृष्टो अग्निः स नो दिवा स रिषस्पातु नक्तम्॥
verses.tr: pṛṣṭo divi pṛṣṭo agniḥ pṛthivyāṃ pṛṣṭo viśvā oṣadhīrā viveśa vaiśvānaraḥ sahasā pṛṣṭo agniḥ sa no divā sa riṣaspātu naktam
verses.en: Sought in the sky, sought on the earth, sought after, all plants that grow on ground hath Agni entered. May Agni, may Vaisvanara with vigour, sought for, by day and night from harm preserve us.

verses.sa: अश्याम तं काममग्ने तवोती अश्याम रयिं रयिवः सुवीरम्। अश्याम वाजमभि वाजयन्तोऽश्याम द्युम्नमजराजरं ते॥
verses.tr: aśyāma taṃ kāmamagne tavotī aśyāma rayiṃ rayivaḥ suvīram aśyāma vājamabhi vājayanto'śyāma dyumnamajarājaraṃ te
verses.en: Help us that we may gain this wish, O Agni, gain riches. Wealthy One! with store of heroes. Desiring strength from thee may we be strengthened, and win, Eternal! thine eternal glory.

verses.sa: वयं ते अद्य ररिमा हि काममुत्तानहस्ता नमसोपसद्य। यजिष्ठेन मनसा यक्षि देवानस्रेधता मन्मना विप्रो अग्ने॥
verses.tr: vayaṃ te adya rarimā hi kāmamuttānahastā namasopasadya yajiṣṭhena manasā yakṣi devānasredhatā manmanā vipro agne
verses.en: Approaching with raised! hands and adoration, we have this day fulfilled for thee thy longing. Worship the Gods with most devoted spirit as Priest with no unfriendly thought, O Agni.

verses.sa: धामच्छदग्निरिन्द्रो ब्रह्मा देवो बृहस्पतिः। सचेतसो विश्वे देवा यज्ञं प्रावन्तु नः शुभे॥
verses.tr: dhāmacchadagnirindro brahmā devo bṛhaspatiḥ sacetaso viśve devā yajñaṃ prāvantu naḥ śubhe
verses.en: Home-leader Agni, Indra, and Brahm&, and bright Bribaspati—May the All-Gods, one-minded, guard. our sacrifice in happy place.

verses.sa: त्वं यविष्ठ दाशुषो नॄँः पाहि शृणुधी गिरः। रक्षा तोकमुत त्मना॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ yaviṣṭha dāśuṣo nṝṃḥ pāhi śṛṇudhī giraḥ rakṣā tokamuta tmanā
verses.en: Guard thou the Sacrificer's men, O Youthfullest, etc., as in
